    49	/-! ## Pair-value algebra of unit cocycles -/
    50	
    51	section EvInf
    52	
    53	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    54	
    55	/-- The underlying section of a restricted unit is the restricted underlying section. -/
    56	private lemma coe_unitsRestrict {W U₀ : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U₀) (u : Γ(X, U₀)ˣ) :
    57	    (X.unitsRestrict h u : Γ(X, W)) = X.resHom h (u : Γ(X, U₀)) :=
    58	  rfl
    59	
    60	/-- **The diagonal pair values of a unit cocycle are `1`**: the cocycle identity at
    61	`(x, x, x)` forces idempotency, and restriction along the (equal-opens) triple overlap
    62	is invertible. -/
    63	lemma Scheme.unitsEvInf_self {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) (x : X) :
    64	    Scheme.unitsEvInf γ x x = 1 := by
    65	  have h2 : X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left :
    66	        𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x)
    67	        (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ x x) *
    68	      X.unitsRestrict inf_le_left (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ x x) =
    69	      X.unitsRestrict inf_le_left (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ x x) :=
    70	    Scheme.unitsEvInf_trans γ x x x
    71	  have h3 : X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left :
    72	      𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x)
    73	      (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ x x) = 1 := mul_eq_right.mp h2
    74	  refine Units.ext ?_
    75	  have h4 := congrArg (fun u : Γ(X, 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x)ˣ =>
    76	    X.resHom (le_inf le_rfl inf_le_left :
    77	      𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x) (u : Γ(X, _))) h3
    78	  simp only [coe_unitsRestrict, Scheme.resHom_resHom, Units.val_one, map_one] at h4
    79	  rw [Units.val_one, ← Scheme.resHom_refl
    80	    (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ x x : Γ(X, 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens x))]
    81	  exact h4
    82	
    83	/-- **The cocycle identity for pair values on any sub-open of the triple overlap**, in
    84	`resHom` form (the shape the datum's `mul_res` law consumes). -/
    85	lemma Scheme.unitsEvInf_mul_res_of_le {𝒰 : X.PointedCover} (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰)
    86	    (x y z : X) {O : X.Opens} (hxy : O ≤ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens y)
    87	    (hyz : O ≤ 𝒰.opens y ⊓ 𝒰.opens z) (hxz : O ≤ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens z) :
    88	    X.resHom hxy (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ x y : Γ(X, 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens y)) *
    89	        X.resHom hyz (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ y z : Γ(X, 𝒰.opens y ⊓ 𝒰.opens z)) =
    90	      X.resHom hxz (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ x z : Γ(X, 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens z)) := by
    91	  have hO : O ≤ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens y ⊓ 𝒰.opens z :=
    92	    le_inf hxy (hyz.trans inf_le_right)
    93	  have h := congrArg (fun u : Γ(X, 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens y ⊓ 𝒰.opens z)ˣ =>
    94	    X.resHom hO (u : Γ(X, _))) (Scheme.unitsEvInf_trans γ x y z)
    95	  simp only [Units.val_mul, map_mul, coe_unitsRestrict, Scheme.resHom_resHom] at h
    96	  exact h
    97	
    98	/-- **Restricted pair values along an anchored family form a gluing cocycle**: for a
    99	unit cocycle `γ` on a pointed cover `𝒰`, an arbitrary family of opens `U : J → X.Opens`
   100	and anchor points with `U j ≤ 𝒰.opens (anchor j)`, the restrictions of the pair values
   101	`γ.evInf (anchor i) (anchor j)` to the double overlaps satisfy the gluing cocycle
   102	law. -/
   103	lemma Scheme.isGluingCocycle_unitsRestrict_evInf {𝒰 : X.PointedCover}
   104	    (γ : X.unitsCocycle 𝒰) {J : Type u} (U : J → X.Opens) (anchor : J → X)
   105	    (hanch : ∀ j : J, U j ≤ 𝒰.opens (anchor j)) :
   106	    Scheme.IsGluingCocycle U (fun i j =>
   107	      X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf (hanch i) (hanch j))
   108	        (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ (anchor i) (anchor j))) := by
   109	  constructor
   110	  · intro i
   111	    rw [Scheme.unitsEvInf_self γ (anchor i), map_one, Units.val_one]
   112	  · intro i j l
   113	    simp only [coe_unitsRestrict, Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   114	    exact Scheme.unitsEvInf_mul_res_of_le γ (anchor i) (anchor j) (anchor l) _ _ _
   115	
   116	end EvInf

   118	/-! ## The affine basic-open refinement of a pointed cover -/
   119	
   120	/-- **Affine refinement of a pointed cover with a partition of unity**: on an affine
   121	open `V`, any pointed cover `𝒰` refines to a finite family of basic opens `D(f i)`,
   122	each contained in the cover member at an anchor point, whose sections admit a partition
   123	of unity `∑ a i · f i = 1` in `Γ(X, V)`. -/
   124	theorem IsAffineOpen.exists_finite_basicOpen_refinement {X : Scheme.{u}} {V : X.Opens}
   125	    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (𝒰 : X.PointedCover) :
   126	    ∃ (ι : Type u) (_ : Fintype ι) (f : ι → Γ(X, V)) (anchor : ι → X)
   127	      (a : ι → Γ(X, V)),
   128	      (∀ i : ι, X.basicOpen (f i) ≤ 𝒰.opens (anchor i)) ∧ ∑ i : ι, a i * f i = 1 := by
   129	  classical
   130	  -- a basic open through every point of `V`, inside the cover member at that point
   131	  have hpt : ∀ p : ↥V, ∃ f : Γ(X, V),
   132	      X.basicOpen f ≤ 𝒰.opens (p : X) ⊓ V ∧ (p : X) ∈ X.basicOpen f := fun p =>
   133	    hV.exists_basicOpen_le (V := 𝒰.opens (p : X) ⊓ V)
   134	      (⟨(p : X), ⟨𝒰.mem_opens (p : X), p.2⟩⟩ : ↥(𝒰.opens (p : X) ⊓ V)) p.2
   135	  choose f hfle hfmem using hpt
   136	  -- a finite subfamily covering the quasi-compact `V`
   137	  have hcov : (V : Set X) ⊆ ⋃ p : ↥V, (X.basicOpen (f p) : Set X) := fun q hq =>
   138	    Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, hfmem ⟨q, hq⟩⟩
   139	  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hV.isCompact.elim_finite_subcover
   140	    (fun p : ↥V => (X.basicOpen (f p) : Set X))
   141	    (fun p => (X.basicOpen (f p)).isOpen) hcov
   142	  -- the finite subfamily, reindexed over the subcover
   143	  have hle : V ≤ ⨆ x : (Set.range fun i : {p : ↥V // p ∈ t} => f (i : ↥V) :
   144	      Set Γ(X, V)), X.basicOpen (x : Γ(X, V)) := by
   145	    intro q hq
   146	    obtain ⟨p, hpt', hpq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht hq)
   147	    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr
   148	      ⟨⟨f p, Set.mem_range_self (⟨p, hpt'⟩ : {p : ↥V // p ∈ t})⟩, hpq⟩
   149	  have hspan : Ideal.span
   150	      (Set.range fun i : {p : ↥V // p ∈ t} => f (i : ↥V)) = ⊤ :=
   151	    hV.self_le_iSup_basicOpen_iff.mp hle
   152	  have hone : (1 : Γ(X, V)) ∈
   153	      Ideal.span (Set.range fun i : {p : ↥V // p ∈ t} => f (i : ↥V)) :=
   154	    (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one _).mp hspan
   155	  rw [Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun] at hone
   156	  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hone
   157	  exact ⟨{p : ↥V // p ∈ t}, inferInstance, fun i => f (i : ↥V),
   158	    fun i => ((i : ↥V) : X), a, fun i => (hfle (i : ↥V)).trans inf_le_left, ha⟩
   159	
   160	/-! ## The datum of a refined pointed cover -/
   161	
   162	section Datum
   163	
   164	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   165	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   166	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
   167	
   168	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   169	
   170	variable (ι₀ ι₁ : Type u) [Fintype ι₀] [Fintype ι₁]
   171	variable (f₀ a₀ : ι₀ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀))
   172	variable (f₁ a₁ : ι₁ → Γ(relCurve C B, (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁))
   173	
   174	/-- The cover data of a chart refinement: the given finite basic-open families with
   175	their partition witnesses. -/
   176	noncomputable def refinementCoverData
   177	    (hpart₀ : ∑ i : ι₀, a₀ i * f₀ i = 1) (hpart₁ : ∑ i : ι₁, a₁ i * f₁ i = 1) :
   178	    BasicOpenCoverData C B π where
   179	  J₀ := ι₀
   180	  J₁ := ι₁
   181	  fintype₀ := inferInstance
   182	  fintype₁ := inferInstance
   183	  h₀ := f₀
   184	  h₁ := f₁
   185	  a₀ := a₀
   186	  a₁ := a₁
   187	  partition₀ := hpart₀
   188	  partition₁ := hpart₁
   189	
   190	variable (𝒰 : (relCurve C B).PointedCover) (γ : (relCurve C B).unitsCocycle 𝒰)
   191	variable (an₀ : ι₀ → relCurve C B) (an₁ : ι₁ → relCurve C B)
   192	variable (hpart₀ : ∑ i : ι₀, a₀ i * f₀ i = 1) (hpart₁ : ∑ i : ι₁, a₁ i * f₁ i = 1)
   193	
   194	/-- The pieces of the refinement cover data are subordinated to the pointed cover at
   195	the anchor points. -/
   196	lemma refinementCoverData_pieces_le
   197	    (hsub₀ : ∀ i : ι₀, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f₀ i) ≤ 𝒰.opens (an₀ i))
   198	    (hsub₁ : ∀ i : ι₁, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f₁ i) ≤ 𝒰.opens (an₁ i))
   199	    (i : (refinementCoverData ι₀ ι₁ f₀ a₀ f₁ a₁ hpart₀ hpart₁).index) :
   200	    (refinementCoverData ι₀ ι₁ f₀ a₀ f₁ a₁ hpart₀ hpart₁).pieces i ≤
   201	      𝒰.opens (Sum.elim an₀ an₁ i) := by
   202	  cases i with
   203	  | inl i =>
   204	    rw [BasicOpenCoverData.pieces_inl]
   205	    exact hsub₀ i
   206	  | inr i =>
   207	    rw [BasicOpenCoverData.pieces_inr]
   208	    exact hsub₁ i
   209	
   210	/-- **The cocycle datum of a refined pointed cover** (stage 1f, the construction):
   211	basic-open generators refining a pointed cover on both pinned charts, with transition
   212	units the restricted pair values of a unit cocycle on the cover. -/
   213	noncomputable def ofRefinement
   214	    (hsub₀ : ∀ i : ι₀, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f₀ i) ≤ 𝒰.opens (an₀ i))
   215	    (hsub₁ : ∀ i : ι₁, (relCurve C B).basicOpen (f₁ i) ≤ 𝒰.opens (an₁ i)) :
   216	    BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π where
   217	  toBasicOpenCoverData := refinementCoverData ι₀ ι₁ f₀ a₀ f₁ a₁ hpart₀ hpart₁
   218	  unit i j := (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict
   219	    (inf_le_inf
   220	      (refinementCoverData_pieces_le ι₀ ι₁ f₀ a₀ f₁ a₁ 𝒰 an₀ an₁ hpart₀ hpart₁
   221	        hsub₀ hsub₁ i)
   222	      (refinementCoverData_pieces_le ι₀ ι₁ f₀ a₀ f₁ a₁ 𝒰 an₀ an₁ hpart₀ hpart₁
   223	        hsub₀ hsub₁ j))
   224	    (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ (Sum.elim an₀ an₁ i) (Sum.elim an₀ an₁ j))
   225	  isGluingCocycle := Scheme.isGluingCocycle_unitsRestrict_evInf γ
   226	    (refinementCoverData ι₀ ι₁ f₀ a₀ f₁ a₁ hpart₀ hpart₁).pieces (Sum.elim an₀ an₁)
   227	    (refinementCoverData_pieces_le ι₀ ι₁ f₀ a₀ f₁ a₁ 𝒰 an₀ an₁ hpart₀ hpart₁
   228	      hsub₀ hsub₁)
   229	
   230	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   231	
   232	/-! ## The class comparison and the extraction keystone -/
   233	
   234	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   235	
   236	/-- **The class of an anchored datum**: a datum whose transition units are the
   237	restricted pair values of a unit cocycle `γ` on a pointed cover `𝒰` (along an anchor
   238	map dominating the pieces) has Čech Picard class `CechPic.mk 𝒰 γ.class`. The
   239	comparison runs on the pointed cover `x ↦ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ pieces (σ x)`, where the two
   240	restricted cocycles are cohomologous through the `0`-cochain
   241	`x ↦ γ.evInf x (anchor (σ x))`. -/
   242	theorem cechPicClass_eq_of_anchor (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
   243	    (𝒰 : (relCurve C B).PointedCover) (γ : (relCurve C B).unitsCocycle 𝒰)
   244	    (anchor : D.index → relCurve C B)
   245	    (hanch : ∀ j : D.index, D.pieces j ≤ 𝒰.opens (anchor j))
   246	    (hunit : ∀ i j : D.index,
   247	      ((D.unit i j : Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)ˣ) :
   248	          Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) =
   249	        (relCurve C B).resHom (inf_le_inf (hanch i) (hanch j))
   250	          (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ (anchor i) (anchor j) :
   251	            Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒰.opens (anchor i) ⊓ 𝒰.opens (anchor j)))) :
   252	    D.cechPicClass = Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒰 γ.class := by
   253	  set 𝒲 : (relCurve C B).PointedCover :=
   254	    ⟨fun x => 𝒰.opens x ⊓ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x),
   255	      fun x => ⟨𝒰.mem_opens x, D.mem_pieces_pieceIndex x⟩⟩ with h𝒲
   256	  have h𝒲𝒰 : 𝒲 ≤ 𝒰 := fun x => inf_le_left
   257	  have hsub : ∀ x : relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens x ≤ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) :=
   258	    fun x => inf_le_right
   259	  -- the subordinated cocycle of the datum and the restricted `γ` are cohomologous
   260	  have hcoh : (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲 D.pieceIndex hsub).IsCohomologous
   261	      (γ.res fun x => homOfLE (h𝒲𝒰 x)) := by
   262	    refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_isCohomologous
   263	      (fun x => (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict
   264	        (le_inf inf_le_left (inf_le_right.trans (hanch (D.pieceIndex x))) :
   265	          𝒲.opens x ≤ 𝒰.opens x ⊓ 𝒰.opens (anchor (D.pieceIndex x)))
   266	        (Scheme.unitsEvInf γ x (anchor (D.pieceIndex x)))) (fun x y => ?_)
   267	    refine Units.ext ?_
   268	    rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_mul, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf,
   269	      Scheme.res_unitsEvInf h𝒲𝒰 γ x y]
   270	    simp only [coe_unitsRestrict, gluedSubordUnit, Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   271	    rw [hunit (D.pieceIndex x) (D.pieceIndex y), Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   272	    have hL := Scheme.unitsEvInf_mul_res_of_le γ x (anchor (D.pieceIndex x))
   273	      (anchor (D.pieceIndex y))
   274	      (O := 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒲.opens y)
   275	      (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans inf_le_left)
   276	        ((inf_le_left.trans inf_le_right).trans (hanch (D.pieceIndex x))))

     8	/-!
     9	# `ModuleCat k`-valued sheaf cohomology and the structure sheaf as a sheaf of modules
    10	
    11	This file provides the cohomology carrier for the genus lane of the Jacobian challenge:
    12	
    13	1. For a small site `(C, J)` and a commutative ring `R`, the degree-`n` cohomology
    14	   `Sheaf.HModule F n` of a sheaf `F` of `R`-modules, defined as the `Ext`-group from the
    15	   constant sheaf with value `R` to `F` (mirroring `CategoryTheory.Sheaf.H`, which is
    16	   `AddCommGrpCat`-valued; ours is `ModuleCat R`-valued so that `Module.finrank` applies).
    17	   Each `Sheaf.HModule F n` is an `R`-module via the `R`-linear structure of the sheaf
    18	   category, and `Sheaf.HModule.map` gives `R`-linear functoriality in `F`.
    19	2. The degree-zero identification `Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀ : HModule F 0 ≃ₗ[R] F(⊤)`
    20	   via `Ext⁰ ≅ Hom` and the constant-sheaf adjunction, together with its naturality.
    21	3. For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, the structure sheaf of `X` as a sheaf of `k`-modules
    22	   `Scheme.moduleKSheaf` on the small Zariski site `Opens.grothendieckTopology X`, by
    23	   restriction of scalars along the structure morphism, with definitional (`rfl`) access
    24	   to its sections and restriction maps.
    25	
    26	## Universe discipline
    27	
    28	Everything is single-universe: `k : Type u`, `X : Scheme.{u}`, the site `Opens X : Type u`
    29	with hom-types in `Type u`, and coefficients `ModuleCat.{u} k`. Then
    30	`Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (ModuleCat.{u} k)` is Grothendieck abelian relative
    31	to `u` (`ModuleCat.{u} k` is, and the site is small), hence `HasExt.{u}` holds and
    32	`Sheaf.HModule F n : Type u` with a `Module k` structure — no universe bump anywhere, so
    33	`Module.finrank k` applies directly downstream.
    34	
    35	## Design notes
    36	
    37	* `Sheaf.HModule` is an `abbrev` for `Abelian.Ext`, so the entire mathlib `Ext` API
    38	  (long exact sequences `Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁/₂/₃`, `Ext.extClass`, the
    39	  Mayer–Vietoris machinery of `CategoryTheory/Sites/SheafCohomology`) applies
    40	  transparently; we do not rebuild any of it.
    41	* No global `Algebra k Γ(X, U)` instance is introduced (it would overlap with mathlib's
    42	  `Algebra R Γ(Spec R, U)` instance via the tautological `OverClass X X`); the module
    43	  structure is carried by the explicit defs `Scheme.overAlgebraMap`/`Scheme.overModule`
    44	  and, where needed, `attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule`.
    45	-/

    64	/-- The constant sheaf of `R`-modules with value `R` on the site `(C, J)`; sheaf cohomology
    65	of sheaves of `R`-modules is `Ext` out of this object. -/
    66	noncomputable def constModuleSheaf : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u} R) :=
    67	  (constantSheaf J (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (ModuleCat.of R R)

    71	/-- The degree-`n` cohomology of a sheaf of `R`-modules on a small site, as an `Ext`-group
    72	in the Grothendieck abelian category `Sheaf J (ModuleCat R)`. It is a `Type u` carrying a
    73	`Module R` instance (via the `R`-linear structure of the sheaf category). -/

    83	  (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f).postcompOfLinear R (constModuleSheaf J R) (add_zero n)
    84	
    85	lemma map_apply (f : F ⟶ G) {n : ℕ} (x : HModule F n) :

    87	
    88	@[simp]
    89	lemma map_id_apply {n : ℕ} (x : HModule F n) : map (𝟙 F) n x = x := by

    92	lemma map_comp_apply (f : F ⟶ G) (g : G ⟶ G') {n : ℕ} (x : HModule F n) :
    93	    map (f ≫ g) n x = map g n (map f n x) := by
    94	  simp [map_apply]

    97	  subsingleton_of_forall_eq 0 fun x ↦ x.eq_zero_of_injective

    12	/-!
    13	# The fibre-restriction seam of the datum engine, closed (DAT-1 (1d-ii) × DAT-3)
    14	
    15	The full `hfib` discharge chain for a pinned basic-open cocycle datum
    16	`D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π` (`informal/spec-dat-1.md` 1d-ii second half — the
    17	"one open seam" of the W6-full chain, `informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §3.1(a)):
    18	
    19	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.subsingleton_h1_tensor_of_baseChange` — **the complex-form
    20	  fibre hypothesis from the fibre datum**: for any `k`-algebra map `B → B'`, vanishing
    21	  of `H¹` of the two-lattice pair of the base-changed datum forces
    22	  `Subsingleton (H¹(pair D) ⊗[B] B')` — the base-changed Čech differential is
    23	  surjective through the landed δ-naturality square (`datumDiffBaseChange`), and the
    24	  cokernel identification is right-exactness (`subsingleton_h1_rTensor_iff`).
    25	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.presentationSheafIso` — **the presentation bridge** (over a
    26	  field): the datum's glued sheaf is isomorphic to the glued sheaf of the meromorphic
    27	  presentation `MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle` of its canonical subordinated
    28	  cocycle — the subordination isomorphism (`gluedSheafSubord`) at the pointed cover by
    29	  pieces; the presented class is `D.cechPicClass` on the nose.
    30	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.subsingleton_sheaf_h1_of_picClass_eq` — **`hfib` in datum
    31	  sheaf form over a field**: vanishing of `H¹(𝒪(W))` for any witness divisor `W` of
    32	  the datum's Čech Picard class discharges `H¹` of the datum's glued sheaf (through
    33	  the presentation bridge and the W6-full export
    34	  `subsingleton_hModule_gluedSheaf_one_of_picClass_eq`).
    35	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.subsingleton_h1_residueField_tensor_of_witness` — **the seam,
    36	  closed**: at a prime `p` of the test ring, a witness divisor of the fibre datum's
    37	  class on the fibre curve `C_{κ(p)}` with vanishing `H¹(𝒪(W))` discharges the
    38	  engine's complex-form fibre hypothesis
    39	  `Subsingleton (H¹(pair D) ⊗[B] κ(p))` (`datumRigidEngine`'s `hfib p`).  The fibre
    40	  curve's instance package fires from `Curve.BaseChangeInstances` (G-D5(a)).
    41	
    42	Everything upstream of the witness hypothesis is unconditional; producing the witness
    43	at a prescribed degree — `cechPicClass_baseChange` plus the degree seam and DAT-0a's
    44	uniform bound — is the consumer's numeric input.
    45	-/

    48	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

    51

    53	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
    54

    56	
    57	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    58

    60	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    61	
    62	open AlgebraicJacobian
    63	
    64	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    65	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    66	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite π]
    67	
    68	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    69	
    70	/-! ## The complex-form fibre hypothesis from the fibre datum -/
    71	
    72	/-- **The complex-form fibre hypothesis from the fibre datum** (the (1d-ii) second
    73	half): for a `k`-algebra `B'` over the test ring, the vanishing of `H¹` of the
    74	two-lattice pair of the base-changed datum forces the vanishing of the base change of
    75	`H¹` of the pair of the datum: the fibre pair's Čech differential is surjective, the
    76	δ-naturality square (`datumDiffBaseChange`) carries surjectivity to the base-changed
    77	differential, and `H¹(pair) ⊗ B'` is its cokernel by right-exactness. -/
    78	theorem subsingleton_h1_tensor_of_baseChange (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
    79	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
    80	    (h : Subsingleton (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).H1) :
    81	    Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] B') := by
    82	  -- the fibre pair's differential is surjective
    83	  have himg : (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).imageLattice = ⊤ :=
    84	    Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mp h
    85	  have hsurj' : Function.Surjective (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff := by
    86	    rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, (datumPair (D.baseChange B')).range_diff_eq]
    87	    exact himg
    88	  -- surjectivity transports backward across the δ-naturality square
    89	  have hsq : ∀ a, (D.termBaseChangeInf B').symm ((datumPair (D.baseChange B')).diff a)
    90	      = ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B') ((D.datumDomBaseChange B').symm a) := by
    91	    intro a
    92	    have hkey := D.datumDiffBaseChange B' ((D.datumDomBaseChange B').symm a)
    93	    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hkey
    94	    rw [← hkey, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    95	  have hbc : Function.Surjective ((datumPair D).diff.baseChange B') :=
    96	    RigidEngine.surjective_congr _ _ (D.datumDomBaseChange B').symm
    97	      (D.termBaseChangeInf B').symm hsq hsurj'
    98	  -- the base change of `H¹` is the cokernel of the base-changed differential
    99	  rw [(datumPair D).subsingleton_h1_rTensor_iff B']
   100	  exact Submodule.Quotient.subsingleton_iff.mpr (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hbc)
   101	
   102	/-- The sheaf-level form: `H¹` of the base-changed datum's glued sheaf vanishing
   103	forces the complex-form fibre hypothesis (through `datumH1Equiv` at the fibre
   104	datum). -/
   105	theorem subsingleton_h1_tensor_of_baseChange_sheaf (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
   106	    (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
   107	    (h : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange B').sheaf 1)) :
   108	    Subsingleton ((datumPair D).H1 ⊗[B] B') :=
   109	  D.subsingleton_h1_tensor_of_baseChange B'
   110	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff (D.baseChange B')).mpr h)
   111	
   112	/-! ## The presentation bridge over a field -/
   113	
   114	section Field
   115	
   116	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   117	variable [IsIntegral (relCurve C K)]
   118	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
   119	variable [QuasiCompact (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
   120	
   121	/-- **The presentation bridge**: over a field, the datum's glued sheaf is isomorphic
   122	to the glued sheaf of the meromorphic presentation of its canonical subordinated
   123	cocycle (`MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle` on the pointed cover by pieces) — the
   124	subordination isomorphism `gluedSheafSubord`.  The presented class is
   125	`E.cechPicClass` by definition. -/
   126	noncomputable def presentationSheafIso (E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C K π) :
   127	    E.sheaf ≅ (Scheme.MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle E.pointedCover
   128	      (gluedSubordCocycle E.isGluingCocycle E.pointedCover E.pieceIndex
   129	        fun _ => le_rfl)).gluedSheaf K :=
   130	  gluedSheafSubord K (σ := E.pieceIndex) (fun _ => le_rfl)
   131	    (fun x y =>
   132	      congrArg Units.val
   133	        (gluedSubordCocycle_evInf E.isGluingCocycle E.pointedCover E.pieceIndex
   134	          (fun _ => le_rfl) x y))
   135	    E.isGluingCocycle
   136	    (fun z => ⟨z, E.pointedCover.mem_opens z⟩)
   137	
   138	/-- **`hfib` in datum sheaf form over a field** (the datum-level face of the W6-full
   139	step (c)+(d) exports): the vanishing of `H¹(𝒪(W))` for any witness divisor `W` of the
   140	datum's Čech Picard class discharges the vanishing of `H¹` of the datum's glued
   141	sheaf. -/
   142	theorem subsingleton_sheaf_h1_of_picClass_eq (E : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C K π)
   143	    {W : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor}
   144	    (hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K W = E.cechPicClass)
   145	    (hvan : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K W) 1)) :
   146	    Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule E.sheaf 1) := by
   147	  have hpres : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   148	      ((Scheme.MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle E.pointedCover
   149	        (gluedSubordCocycle E.isGluingCocycle E.pointedCover E.pieceIndex
   150	          fun _ => le_rfl)).gluedSheaf K) 1) :=
   151	    subsingleton_hModule_gluedSheaf_one_of_picClass_eq K _ hW hvan
   152	  exact (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv (presentationSheafIso E) 1).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mpr
   153	    hpres
   154	
   155	end Field
   156	
   157	/-! ## The seam, closed: the engine's fibre hypothesis from a fibre witness -/
   158

   221	/-! ## The class of the pinned cocycle datum -/
   222	
   223	section Datum
   224	
   225	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   226	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
   227	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
   228	
   229	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   230	
   231	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
   232	
   233	/-- Every point of the relative curve lies in a piece of the datum: the two pinned
   234	charts cover the curve and each chart is covered by its basic-open pieces. -/
   235	lemma exists_mem_pieces (x : relCurve C B) : ∃ j : D.index, x ∈ D.pieces j := by
   236	  have hx : x ∈ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ ⊔ (relCover C B (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ := by
   237	    rw [relCover_sup]
   238	    trivial
   239	  rcases (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_sup).mp hx with h0 | h1
   240	  · have hcov := D.cover₀ h0
   241	    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hcov
   242	    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov
   243	    exact ⟨Sum.inl j, hj⟩
   244	  · have hcov := D.cover₁ h1
   245	    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] at hcov
   246	    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov
   247	    exact ⟨Sum.inr j, hj⟩
   248	
   249	/-- A choice of piece through every point of the relative curve. -/
   250	noncomputable def pieceIndex (x : relCurve C B) : D.index :=
   251	  (D.exists_mem_pieces x).choose
   252	
   253	lemma mem_pieces_pieceIndex (x : relCurve C B) : x ∈ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) :=
   254	  (D.exists_mem_pieces x).choose_spec
   255	
   256	/-- **The canonical pointed cover by pieces** of the datum. -/
   257	noncomputable def pointedCover : (relCurve C B).PointedCover where
   258	  opens x := D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x)
   259	  mem_opens x := D.mem_pieces_pieceIndex x
   260	
   261	@[simp]
   262	lemma pointedCover_opens (x : relCurve C B) :
   263	    D.pointedCover.opens x = D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) := rfl
   264	
   265	/-- **The Čech Picard class of the pinned cocycle datum** (stage 1e): the class of the
   266	subordinated unit cocycle on the canonical pointed cover by pieces. By
   267	`cechPicClass_eq_mk` it is computed by **any** pointed cover subordinated to the
   268	pieces. -/
   269	noncomputable def cechPicClass : (relCurve C B).CechPic :=
   270	  Scheme.CechPic.mk D.pointedCover
   271	    (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
   272	      (fun _ => le_rfl)).class
   273	
   274	/-- **The class law on subordinated covers**: the class of the datum is computed by the
   275	subordinated cocycle on any pointed cover subordinated to the pieces (the interface the
   276	stage-(1f) extraction and DAT-3 consume). -/
   277	theorem cechPicClass_eq_mk (𝒲 : (relCurve C B).PointedCover) (σ : relCurve C B → D.index)
   278	    (hσ : ∀ x : relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x)) :
   279	    Scheme.CechPic.mk 𝒲 (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲 σ hσ).class =
   280	      D.cechPicClass :=
   281	  gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲 D.pointedCover σ D.pieceIndex hσ
   282	    (fun _ => le_rfl)
   283	
   284	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

   286	/-! ## Naturality of the class in the test ring -/
   287	
   288	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   289	
   290	variable (B' : Type u) [CommRing B'] [Algebra k B'] [Algebra B B'] [IsScalarTower k B B']
   291	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π)
   292	
   293	/-- The pullback of the canonical pointed cover is subordinated to the pieces of the
   294	base-changed datum (pieces base-change to pieces). -/
   295	lemma pullback_pointedCover_le (x : relCurve C B') :
   296	    (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).opens x ≤
   297	      (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x)) := by
   298	  rw [Scheme.PointedCover.pullback_opens, pointedCover_opens]
   299	  exact (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.pieces_baseChange B'
   300	    (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))).ge
   301	
   302	/-- (Implementation) **The pulled-back subordinated cocycle is the subordinated cocycle
   303	of the base-changed datum**: comparing pair values, both are one `appLE` of the
   304	transition unit. -/
   305	lemma pullbackUnitsCocycle_gluedSubordCocycle :
   306	    (relCurveMap C B B').pullbackUnitsCocycle
   307	      (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
   308	        (fun _ => le_rfl)) =
   309	    gluedSubordCocycle (D.baseChange B').isGluingCocycle
   310	      (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B'))
   311	      (fun x => D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))
   312	      (fun x => D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' x) := by
   313	  refine Scheme.unitsCocycle_ext fun x y => ?_
   314	  rw [Scheme.Hom.pullbackUnitsCocycle_unitsEvInf, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf,
   315	    gluedSubordCocycle_evInf]
   316	  refine Units.ext ?_
   317	  rw [Scheme.Hom.coe_unitsAppLE, gluedSubordUnit, gluedSubordUnit,
   318	    coe_unitsRestrict, coe_unitsRestrict]
   319	  -- left side: `appLE` of the restricted unit collapses to one `appLE`
   320	  have hL := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
   321	    $(Scheme.Hom.map_appLE (relCurveMap C B B')
   322	      ((relCurveMap C B B').le_preimage_inf
   323	        (inf_le_left : (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).opens x ⊓
   324	          (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).opens y ≤
   325	            (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).opens x)
   326	        (inf_le_right))
   327	      (homOfLE (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans le_rfl) (inf_le_right.trans le_rfl) :
   328	        D.pointedCover.opens ((relCurveMap C B B').base x) ⊓
   329	          D.pointedCover.opens ((relCurveMap C B B').base y) ≤
   330	            D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x)) ⊓
   331	              D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y)))).op))
   332	    ((D.unit (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))
   333	        (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y)) :
   334	      Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x)) ⊓
   335	        D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y))))))
   336	  -- right side: restriction of the base-changed unit collapses to one `appLE`
   337	  have hR := congr((CommRingCat.Hom.hom
   338	    $(Scheme.Hom.appLE_map (relCurveMap C B B')
   339	      (D.toBasicOpenCoverData.baseChange_inf_le_preimage B'
   340	        (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))
   341	        (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y)))
   342	      (homOfLE (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' x))
   343	        (inf_le_right.trans (D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' y)) :
   344	        (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).opens x ⊓
   345	          (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B')).opens y ≤
   346	            (D.baseChange B').pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x)) ⊓
   347	              (D.baseChange B').pieces
   348	                (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y)))).op))
   349	    ((D.unit (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))
   350	        (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y)) :
   351	      Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x)) ⊓
   352	        D.pieces (D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base y))))))
   353	  exact hL.trans hR.symm
   354	
   355	/-- **Naturality of the class in the test ring** (stage 1e, last clause): the Čech
   356	Picard class of the base-changed datum is the pullback of the class of the datum along
   357	the relative-curve comparison morphism. -/
   358	theorem cechPicClass_baseChange :
   359	    (D.baseChange B').cechPicClass =
   360	      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B B') D.cechPicClass := by
   361	  calc (D.baseChange B').cechPicClass
   362	      = Scheme.CechPic.mk (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B'))
   363	          (gluedSubordCocycle (D.baseChange B').isGluingCocycle
   364	            (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B'))
   365	            (fun x => D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))
   366	            (fun x => D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' x)).class :=
   367	        ((D.baseChange B').cechPicClass_eq_mk
   368	          (D.pointedCover.pullback (relCurveMap C B B'))
   369	          (fun x => D.pieceIndex ((relCurveMap C B B').base x))
   370	          (fun x => D.pullback_pointedCover_le B' x)).symm
   371	    _ = Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C B B') D.cechPicClass := by
   372	        rw [← D.pullbackUnitsCocycle_gluedSubordCocycle B']
   373	        rfl
   374	
   375	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   376	
   377	end Datum
   378	
   379	end AlgebraicGeometry

   113	/-! ## Meromorphic presentations -/
   114	
   115	/-- A **meromorphic presentation** of a Čech Picard class on an integral scheme: a
   116	pointed cover, a unit cocycle on it, and rational functions `elem x ∈ K(X)ˣ`, one per
   117	member, whose ratios are the germs at `η` of the cocycle values:
   118	`elem x / elem y = germ_η (cocycle x y)`.
   119	
   120	The elements `elem` are a meromorphic trivialization of the class `picClass` of the
   121	cocycle; their zero/pole orders cut out its divisor
   122	(`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PresentationDivisor`). -/
   123	structure MeromorphicPresentation (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral X] : Type u where
   124	  /-- The pointed cover carrying the presented cocycle. -/
   125	  cover : X.PointedCover
   126	  /-- The presented unit Čech 1-cocycle. -/
   127	  cocycle : X.unitsCocycle cover
   128	  /-- The meromorphic trivialization: one unit of the function field per member. -/
   129	  elem : X → X.functionFieldˣ
   130	  /-- The ratio property: on each pair, the ratio of the trivializing elements is the
   131	  germ at `η` of the cocycle value. -/
   132	  ratio : ∀ x y : X, elem x * (elem y)⁻¹
   133	    = germGenericUnits (cover.genericPoint_mem_inf x y) (unitsEvInf cocycle x y)

   146	    X.MeromorphicPresentation where
   147	  cover := 𝒰
   148	  cocycle := γ
   149	  elem x := germGenericUnits (𝒰.genericPoint_mem_inf x (genericPoint X))

   160	    exact key.symm

     8	/-!
     9	# Subordination invariance of the glued sheaf (the W6-full fibre-restriction bridge)
    10	
    11	For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, pieces `U : J → X.Opens` carrying a gluing cocycle `g`,
    12	and a second covering family `V : I → X.Opens` subordinated to the pieces along
    13	`σ : I → J` (`V i ≤ U (σ i)`), the glued sheaf of the restricted transition units on
    14	`V` is isomorphic to the glued sheaf of `g` on `U`:
    15	
    16	* `AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSubordFwd` — componentwise restriction of glued sections
    17	  `F_g(W) → F_{g'}(W)`, `s ↦ (res s_{σ i})_i`;
    18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSubordSection` — the inverse assembly: the `j`-th component
    19	  of a `V`-glued family `t` glues from the candidates `g j (σ i) · t_i` over the cover
    20	  `{W ⊓ U j ⊓ V i}_i` (the cocycle law makes them compatible);
    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSubordEquiv` — the `k`-linear equivalence of glued sections,
    22	  natural in `W` (`gluedSubordEquiv_res`);
    23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.gluedSheafSubord` — **the sheaf isomorphism**
    24	  `gluedSheaf k U g ≅ gluedSheaf k V g'`;
    25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.subsingleton_hModule_gluedSheaf_subord` — cohomology-vanishing
    26	  transport across the isomorphism.
    27	
    28	The target multipliers `g'` are abstract — the hypothesis `hg'` pins their underlying
    29	sections to the restricted transition units `g (σ i) (σ i')` — so the isomorphism
    30	instantiates on the nose at the subordinated unit cocycle of a pinned basic-open
    31	cocycle datum (`gluedSubordUnit`, `gluedSubordCocycle_evInf`): the datum's glued sheaf
    32	against the glued sheaf of the meromorphic presentation
    33	`MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle` of its Čech Picard class. That instantiation — the
    34	step-(c) bridge of the W6-full fibre-restriction seam — is in
    35	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.GluedSheafDatumFibre`.
    36	-/

    14	This file records the part of the separably-closed cover argument that is already consumable by

    21	`PicRankOneOpen` is deliberately not inferred from `h0 = 1` and `H1 = 0`: no such producer is
    22	landed in the current API.  The final theorem therefore exposes the field-level consumer and
    23	keeps that family producer as an explicit integration obligation.

    54	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

    57	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]

    59	/-- The FLV class theorem in the spelling used by the translated-cover lane.
    60	
    61	The class `l` is the presenting class of the input fibre, while `theta` is the positive
    62	base-field twist.  Keeping this as a named wrapper makes the positive-twist step visible at the
    63	call site; it does not manufacture a presentation or hide the input class in an unrelated
    64	existential. -/
    65	theorem exists_positive_twist_vanishing
    66	    (π : Y ⟶ P1 K) [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
    67	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap K = Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    68	    (l θ : Y.CechPic) (hθ : 1 ≤ classDeg K θ) :
    69	    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n₀, ∀ W : Y.CurveDivisor,
    70	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K W = l * θ ^ n →
    71	        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W) 1) := by
    72	  exact exists_subsingleton_hModule_one_of_one_le_classDeg_of_isFinite_toP1
    73	    π hπ l θ hθ

    79	section DropPackage

    81	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    82	  [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
    83	  [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]

    85	/-- Data for the positive twist and the subsequent point subtraction.
    86	
    87	`hM₀` ties the splitting field presentation to the particular input `mu`; `hW₀` says that the
    88	divisor being reduced is in the positive twist class (the chart index is zero at this stage).
    89	`baseSubtraction` is intentionally an explicit class-level bridge: it says that the divisor
    90	returned by the greedy reduction is represented by a base-field divisor.  The current tree has
    91	the graph-class version of this bridge but no divisor pullback operation, so this hypothesis is
    92	kept visible rather than replaced by a fieldwise existential. -/
    93	structure SepClosedTranslatedDropData (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) where
    94	  m : ℕ
    95	  M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic
    96	  hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =
    97	    PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀)
    98	  W₀ : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor
    99	  hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   100	    M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   101	      (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor))
   102	  genusValue : ℕ
   103	  excess : ℕ
   104	  hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genusValue : ℤ)
   105	  hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genusValue : ℤ) + excess
   106	  h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   107	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)
   108	  P : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   109	  hdense : ∀ U : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).Opens,
   110	    (U : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)).Nonempty → (P ∩ U).Nonempty
   111	  hPcl : ∀ x ∈ P, x ≠ genericPoint ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   112	  hPdeg : ∀ x ∈ P, ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L x = 1
   113	  baseSubtraction : ∀ (S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
   114	    0 ≤ S → Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L S = (excess : ℤ) →
   115	      (∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint _),
   116	        coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ P) →
   117	      ∃ Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor,
   118	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   119	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   120	            ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹)
   121	
   122	/-- The output of the positive-twist/drop construction, tied to both the input class and the
   123	base-field translating divisor.
   124	
   125	The final field is the existing fibre consumer.  In particular, `S` is not merely a divisor
   126	with the right cohomology: `baseClass` identifies its class with the base change of `Z`, and
   127	`translated` is about `mu` translated by the resulting base-field class
   128	`chartTwistClass C d.m Z`. -/
   129	structure SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   130	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ) where
   131	  S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor
   132	  Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor
   133	  nonnegative : 0 ≤ S
   134	  degree : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L S = (d.excess : ℤ)
   135	  support : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint _),
   136	    coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ d.P
   137	  baseClass : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   138	    Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹)
   139	  h0_one : Sheaf.h0
   140	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - S)) = 1
   141	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   142	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - S)) 1)
   143	  translated : IsSplitWitness C
   144	    (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) (overSpec k K))
   145	
   146	/-- Positive twisting followed by point subtraction produces the exact field-level translated
   147	rank-one witness.
   148	
   149	The greedy theorem supplies `S`, `h0 = 1`, and preservation of `H1 = 0`.  The explicit
   150	`baseSubtraction` bridge then supplies the base divisor `Z`; class arithmetic shows that
   151	`W₀ - S` presents `mu` translated by the base-field class `chartTwistClass C d.m Z`.  The last
   152	line applies the existing `IsSplitWitness` consumer, so no unrelated Picard class can satisfy
   153	the conclusion. -/
   154	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult
   155	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   156	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ) :
   157	    Nonempty (SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ d) := by
   158	  obtain ⟨-, S, hS0, hSdeg, hSsupport, hS0one, hS1⟩ :=
   159	    exists_isSplitWitness_of_drop C μ d.m
   160	      (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   161	      d.genusValue d.excess d.hχ d.M₀ d.hM₀ d.W₀ d.hW₀ d.hdeg d.h1
   162	      d.P d.hdense d.hPcl d.hPdeg
   163	  obtain ⟨Z, hSZ⟩ := d.baseSubtraction S hS0 hSdeg hSsupport
   164	  have hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - S) =
   165	      d.M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   166	        (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) := by
   167	    have hW₀ := d.hW₀
   168	    unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hW₀ hSZ ⊢
   169	    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add, Scheme.picClass_neg,
   170	      hW₀, hSZ]
   171	    simp only [map_inv, inv_inv]
   172	    rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
   173	    simp only [chartTwistClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero, inv_one, mul_one,
   174	      pow_zero, one_mul]
   175	  have htranslated : IsSplitWitness C
   176	      (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) (overSpec k K)) :=
   177	    isSplitWitness_of_witness_twistClass C μ d.m Z d.M₀ d.hM₀
   178	      (d.W₀ - S) hW hS1
   179	  exact ⟨{
   180	    S := S
   181	    Z := Z
   182	    nonnegative := hS0
   183	    degree := hSdeg
   184	    support := hSsupport
   185	    baseClass := hSZ
   186	    h0_one := hS0one
   187	    h1_vanishing := hS1
   188	    translated := htranslated
   189	  }⟩
   190	
   191	end DropPackage

   193	end

    10	/-!
    11	# The translated cover in the genus-degree layer
    12	
    13	The separably closed translated-drop producer already supplies an exact lambda-tied
    14	`IsSplitWitness`.  This file records the additional degree calculation needed to place that
    15	translated class in the native `picDegLayer C (genus C)` carrier.  The calculation uses the
    16	actual residual class `W₀ - S`, its base subtraction, and the presenting equation for the original
    17	input class; it does not replace the input by a fieldwise existential.
    18	
    19	The arbitrary-affine `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` family remains a separate integration
    20	obligation.  Consequently this file stops at the exact ambient layer consumed by `PicRankOneOpen`
    21	and does not assert locus membership without that protected presentation producer.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    26	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    27	
    28	universe u
    29	
    30	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
    32	
    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    34	
    35	open AlgebraicJacobian

    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    41	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    42	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    43	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    44	
    45	noncomputable section
    46	
    47	/-! A field point of `overSpec k K` is induced by its structure-field map, so degree at that
    48	point agrees with degree at the identity.  Keeping this local avoids enlarging the base-change
    49	API for a fact used only by the layer bridge. -/
    50	private theorem degAt_eq_degAt_id_of_overSpec
    51	    {K K' : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Field K'] [Algebra k K']
    52	    (lam : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    53	    (t : overSpec k K' ⟶ overSpec k K) :
    54	    degAt lam t = degAt lam (𝟙 (overSpec k K)) := by
    55	  let phiRing : K →+* K' := (Spec.preimage t.left).hom
    56	  have hw : t.left ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) =
    57	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K')) := by
    58	    change t.left ≫ (overSpec k K).hom = (overSpec k K').hom
    59	    exact Over.w t
    60	  have hcat :
    61	      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K) ≫ Spec.preimage t.left =
    62	        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K') := by
    63	    calc
    64	      _ = Spec.preimage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) ≫
    65	          Spec.preimage t.left := by rw [Spec.preimage_map]
    66	      _ = Spec.preimage
    67	          (t.left ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) :=
    68	        (Spec.preimage_comp t.left
    69	          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).symm
    70	      _ = Spec.preimage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K'))) :=
    71	        congrArg Spec.preimage hw
    72	      _ = _ := Spec.preimage_map _
    73	  have hcomm : ∀ x : k,
    74	      phiRing (algebraMap k K x) = algebraMap k K' x := by
    75	    intro x
    76	    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom hcat) x
    77	  let phi : K →ₐ[k] K' := AlgHom.mk phiRing hcomm
    78	  have ht : Over.overSpecMap phi = t := by
    79	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
    80	    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom) = t.left
    81	    rw [show CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom = Spec.preimage t.left from rfl,
    82	      Spec.map_preimage]
    83	  rw [← ht]
    84	  calc
    85	    degAt lam (Over.overSpecMap phi) =
    86	        degAt lam (Over.overSpecMap phi ≫ 𝟙 (overSpec k K)) := by
    87	      rw [Category.comp_id]
    88	    _ = degAt lam (𝟙 (overSpec k K)) :=
    89	      degAt_overSpecMap lam phi (𝟙 (overSpec k K))

    91	section Layer
    92	
    93	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    94	  [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
    95	
    96	/-- The exact degree-genus-layer object carried by a translated-drop result.
    97	
    98	The underlying class is the result's translated input, and the subtype proof is computed from
    99	the residual class `W₀ - S`.  Thus the output is directly an element of the `picDegLayer` target
   100	used by `PicRankOneOpen`, rather than a parallel existential carrier. -/
   101	noncomputable def SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.rankOneLayer
   102	    (mu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   103	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu)
   104	    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu d) :
   105	    picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K) := by
   106	  let translated : picEt C (overSpec k K) := mu * thetaFamily C
   107	    (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) (overSpec k K)
   108	  have hgenusInt : (d.genusValue : ℤ) = (genus C : ℤ) := by
   109	    have hchiC := chi_moduleKSheaf C
   110	    linarith [d.hχ]
   111	  have hW₀ := d.hW₀
   112	  have hSZ := r.baseClass
   113	  have hW :
   114	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - r.S) =
   115	        d.M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   116	          (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) := by
   117	    unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hW₀ hSZ ⊢
   118	    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add,
   119	      Scheme.picClass_neg, hW₀, hSZ]
   120	    simp only [map_inv, inv_inv]
   121	    rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
   122	    simp only [chartTwistClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero,
   123	      inv_one, mul_one, pow_zero, one_mul]
   124	  have hpresentation :=
   125	    picEtAffineEquiv_map_chartTwistFactor_eq_unit
   126	      C mu d.M₀ d.hM₀ d.m r.Z
   127	  have hdegreeAtId :
   128	      degAt translated (𝟙 (overSpec k K)) = (genus C : ℤ) := by
   129	    unfold translated degAt
   130	    rw [picEtMap_id]
   131	    rw [← classDeg_presenting_eq_degAff C L _ _ hpresentation]
   132	    rw [← hW, classDeg_picClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' L, d.hdeg,
   133	      r.degree, hgenusInt]
   134	    ring
   135	  refine ⟨translated, ?_⟩
   136	  intro K' _ _ t
   137	  rw [degAt_eq_degAt_id_of_overSpec]
   138	  exact hdegreeAtId
   139	
   140	@[simp]
   141	theorem SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.rankOneLayer_coe
   142	    (mu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   143	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu)
   144	    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu d) :
   145	    (r.rankOneLayer mu d).1 =
   146	      mu * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) (overSpec k K) := by
   147	  rfl
   148	
   149	theorem SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.rankOneLayer_isSplitWitness
   150	    (mu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   151	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu)
   152	    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu d) :
   153	    IsSplitWitness C (r.rankOneLayer mu d).1 := by
   154	  rw [SepClosedTranslatedDropResult.rankOneLayer_coe]
   155	  exact r.translated
   156	
   157	end Layer

   162	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]

   164	/-- The general per-`K`/per-`mu` producer, now with its translated witness in the native
   165	genus-degree layer.  The final arbitrary-affine presentation family is intentionally not hidden:
   166	the returned subtype is the exact input that a later `PicRankOneOpen` producer must present. -/
   167	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedRankOneLayer_general
   168	    (mu : picEt C (overSpec k K)) :
   169	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
   170	        (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
   171	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
   172	        (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) mu)
   173	        (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) mu d),
   174	      IsSplitWitness C (r.rankOneLayer mu d).1 := by
   175	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, ⟨r⟩⟩ :=
   176	    exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult_general (C := C) mu
   177	  letI := hLfield
   178	  letI := hkL
   179	  letI := hKL
   180	  letI := htow
   181	  letI := hfin
   182	  letI := hsep
   183	  exact ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r,
   184	    r.rankOneLayer_isSplitWitness mu d⟩
   185
